results.content: If multiple EditorConfig files have matching sections, the rules from the closer EditorConfig file are read last, so pairs in closer files take precedence.

provenance.locator: Release v0.17.2, index.rst, File Processing, lines 205–207. One exact sentence with source line wrapping normalized to spaces.

query: The repository-root .editorconfig has root = true and a matching section with indent_style = space and end_of_line = lf. No configuration outside these two paths can apply. scripts/.editorconfig exists. Its entire contents are one matching section with insert_final_newline = true and no other settings. Under EditorConfig 0.17.2, what are the effective indent_style and end_of_line for scripts/check.py, and what, if anything, depends on an unobserved configuration?
